description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message TEXT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000.
  save: --message commit subject, required, must be a single non-empty line; --body commit body, may span multiple lines; --dry-run report what would be staged and committed without changing anything.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB hours and flush buffer", "--body", "Added three time entries and two actions."]
  ["save", "--message", "Update thread metadata", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write the message from what it shows; do not commit blind.
  `save` stages everything in the vault. It only ever adds a commit — never amends, rebases, resets, checks out, or pushes.
  Exit 1 when --message is empty or multi-line, when the vault root is not a directory or not the root of its git repository, or when a git call fails.
